items.q: What single phone setting change cut ~1 hour of use per day in Yousef's lab?
items.a: **Grayscale** — lower color saturation makes the phone less neurologically stimulating and easier to put down.

items.q: Why does short-form infinite scroll hook so hard?
items.a: It copies the **intermittent variable reward** casino playbook: unpredictable jackpots keep you scrolling even when you remember nothing afterward.

items.q: What are the five steps of a focus sprint?
items.a: **Calendar-block ahead → define a specific execution list → cut distractions → countdown timer → real brain break** (not scrolling).

items.q: How many MITs should you pick per day?
items.a: **1–3 most important tasks**; let LITs fill the leftover gaps instead of eating deep-work hours.
Unfinished context you **carry into the next task** after switching; get cognitive closure before you start the next box.

items.q: What kind of break best restores focus after a sprint?
items.a: **Nature exposure**, then doing nothing / hands-busy routines; TikTok-style scrolling is the worst "break."
